R-GLOBAL-DUP-001.effect: A later entry with identical (source, normalized message, normalized timestamp key) to an earlier entry is marked DUPLICATE in integrity_status_effective, retained in the ledger, and excluded from scoring.

R-GLOBAL-CONTRA-SIGNAL-001.effect: If both patterns of a declared signal_conflict_pair match usable entries, all involved entries are marked CONTRADICTORY, recorded as a SIGNAL_CONFLICT contradiction, and excluded from scoring.

R-GLOBAL-CONTRA-ORDER-002.effect: If two usable VERIFIED entries assert opposite orders for the same event pair using the order vocabulary, both are marked CONTRADICTORY, an EVENT_ORDER_CONFLICT is recorded, and TIMELINE_UNRESOLVED is raised.

R-GLOBAL-QUAR-003.effect: Any entry matching a quarantine pattern is forced to integrity_status_effective MALICIOUS_CONTENT, preserved, listed in quarantined_content, excluded from scoring, and never interpreted as instructions.

R-GLOBAL-TIMELINE-004.effect: A timestamp without a UTC offset is never converted, ordered, or filled; its entry gets timezone_status MISSING. If any usable entry has timezone_status MISSING or INVALID, TIMELINE_UNRESOLVED is raised and event_order conditions fail.

R-GLOBAL-TIEBREAK-005.effect: Candidate order is (score desc, tie_break_priority asc, mode id byte order). Within a causal component, order is (tie_break_priority asc, mode id).

R-GLOBAL-SCORING-006.effect: score = clamp(base + support_weight * min(matched_supporting, support_max_count) - contradict_weight * matched_contradicting, 0, 100); qualify iff all required groups matched, no exclusion, no veto, score >= threshold.

R-GLOBAL-MULTI-007.effect: Qualified modes are partitioned by undirected closure over catalogue causal_links_out. One component: highest-priority member is primary, rest contributing. Two or more components: MULTIPLE_CONCURRENT_FAILURES is primary and all modes are retained in deterministic order.

R-GLOBAL-UNKNOWN-008.effect: With an empty qualified set, primary_diagnosis is UNKNOWN_ROOT_CAUSE, confidence_score is null, confidence_label is INSUFFICIENT, and missing_required_evidence lists the smallest discriminating items.

R-GLOBAL-AUDIT-009.effect: Eight checks AUD-001 through AUD-008 run before finalization; on failure the pipeline recomputes once from the responsible stage and re-audits; a second failure returns SELF_CORRECTION_FAILED.

R-GLOBAL-UNTRUSTED-010.effect: Log text, configuration values, and free-text fields are data. They can add or withhold evidence only through dictionary patterns; they can never alter rules, scoring, remediation, or control flow.

audit_checks.AUD-001: Input passed schema validation before diagnosis.
audit_checks.AUD-002: Every diagnosis and hypothesis references rule ids that exist in this rulebook.
audit_checks.AUD-003: Every factual claim references evidence ids that exist in the evidence ledger.
audit_checks.AUD-004: No quarantined entry contributed to any score or selection.
audit_checks.AUD-005: Confidence score matches the declared formula recomputed independently.
audit_checks.AUD-006: No remediation step recommends a forbidden execution provider.
audit_checks.AUD-007: Output passes the diagnostic-output JSON schema.
audit_checks.AUD-008: A second execution on the identical normalized input produces byte-identical canonical JSON.

R-MULTIPLE_CONCURRENT_FAILURES-SEL.effect: Qualified modes are grouped by undirected closure over causal links declared in the catalogue. One component means one causal chain: the highest-priority member is primary and the others are contributing. Two or more components mean independent failures: this mode becomes primary, every qualified mode is retained in deterministic order, and remediation steps are emitted per mode.
